hero.title: Range of Open Models, Open-Source Software, and Open Data.

intro.title:
Tools and Data
Supported or Built by Us
paragraphs: Open tools and data ensure transparency and reproducibility, collaboration and innovation, flexibility and speed, interoperability, capacity development, and lower cost.
We support a range of open models, open-source software, and open data. We are technology-agnostic with extensive expertise in PyPSA, Temoa, TIMES, and others.

cta.heading: Discuss a Technology Modelling Need
cta.text: If you are interested in collaborating with us on energy transition studies, open-source platforms, and training and support, please contact us.
